title: Piperine analogs arrest c-myc gene leading to downregulation of transcription for targeting cancer.
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过生物物理与分子动力学模拟分析胡椒碱类似物PIP-2与c-myc基因启动子G-四链体DNA的相互作用并抑制转录，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作相关机制但核心是配体-G4 DNA结合，非TF-DNA体系，方法以MD为主，与本课题部分相关。
abstract: G-quadruplex (G4) structures are considered a promising therapeutic target in cancer. Since Ayurveda, Piperine has been known for its medicinal properties. Piperine shows anticancer properties by stabilizing the G4 motif present upstream of the c-myc gene. This gene belongs to a group of proto-oncogenes, and its aberrant transcription drives tumorigenesis. The transcriptional regulation of the c-myc gene is an interesting approach for anticancer drug design. The present study employed a chemical similarity approach to identify Piperine similar compounds and analyzed their interaction with cancer-associated G-quadruplex motifs. Among all Piperine analogs, PIP-2 exhibited strong selectivity, specificity, and affinity towards c-myc G4 DNA as elaborated through biophysical studies such as fluorescence emission, isothermal calorimetry, and circular dichroism. Moreover, our biophysical observations are supported by molecular dynamics analysis and cellular-based studies. Our study showed that PIP-2 showed higher toxicity against the A549 lung cancer cell line but lower toxicity towards normal HEK 293 cells, indicating increased efficacy of the drug at the cellular level. Biological evaluation assays such as TFP reporter assay, quantitative real-time PCR (qRT- PCR), and western blotting suggest that the Piperine analog-2 (PIP-2) stabilizes the G-quadruplex motif located at the promoter site of c-myc oncogene and downregulates its expression. In conclusion, Piperine analog PIP-2 may be used as anticancer therapeutics as it affects the c-myc oncogene expression via G-quadruplex mediated mechanism.
abstract_zh: G-四链体（G-quadruplex, G4）结构被认为是癌症中一个有前景的治疗靶点。自阿育吠陀时代以来，胡椒碱（Piperine）因其药用特性而闻名。胡椒碱通过稳定c-myc基因上游的G4基序展现出抗癌特性。该基因属于原癌基因家族，其异常转录驱动肿瘤发生。c-myc基因的转录调控是抗癌药物设计的一个有趣途径。本研究采用化学相似性方法识别与胡椒碱相似的化合物，并分析它们与癌症相关G-四链体基序的相互作用。在所有胡椒碱类似物中，PIP-2对c-myc G4 DNA表现出强烈的选择性、特异性和亲和力，这通过荧光发射、等温量热法和圆二色性等生物物理研究得以详细阐述。此外，我们的生物物理观察得到了分子动力学分析和细胞水平研究的支持。我们的研究表明，PIP-2对A549肺癌细胞系表现出较高的毒性，但对正常HEK 293细胞毒性较低，表明该药物在细胞水平上具有更高的效力。TFP报告基因检测、定量实时PCR（qRT-PCR）和蛋白质印迹等生物学评估实验表明，胡椒碱类似物-2（PIP-2）稳定位于c-myc癌基因启动子位点的G-四链体基序并下调其表达。总之，胡椒碱类似物PIP-2可能作为抗癌治疗药物，因为它通过G-四链体介导的机制影响c-myc癌基因表达。
